# Go 1.27 Release Notes

## Introduction to Go 1.27

The latest Go release, version 1.27, arrives six months after Go 1.26. Most of its changes are in the implementation of the toolchain, runtime, and libraries.

## Changes to the language

Methods may now have type parameters (generic methods).

## Tools

The go command caches test fuzzing corpora per module.

## Runtime

The goroutine leak detector is enabled by default in tests.

## Standard library

The new encoding/json/v2 package is the default JSON implementation. The new crypto/mlkem hybrid key exchange is on by default in crypto/tls.
